repos_data.description: Free, open source voice dictation for macOS. On-device transcription with Apple's Speech framework. No cloud/no API keys/no account.
Open-source macOS dictation that turns speech into polished text in the app you're already using. Powered by AssemblyAI.

repo_meta_data.description: The free, open-source, on-device Grammarly alternative for Mac and Windows. Spelling, grammar, tone checks and rewrites in Slack, Teams, Outlook, Mail & Zoom — powered by Apple Intelligence and Windows Phi Silica; your text never leaves your device.
